component.name: VPNPilot
component.summary: Proton VPN tray controller for Fedora KDE

description.p: VPNPilot is an unofficial tray application that wraps the official Proton VPN Linux CLI. It provides status, presets, diagnostics, and troubleshooting help for Fedora KDE testing.
VPNPilot is not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG and does not use Proton branding.
